# Trina AX

> A self-hosted team workspace connecting company files and per-person folder permissions to Claude Code and the Codex CLI.

The server runs on Linux or an office Mac; Trina also offers hosting. Clients include web, Windows desktop,
Mac desktop source and mobile web. A Mac desktop DMG is not distributed yet. The OpenAI-compatible API engine is
experimental. Files and chats are stored on the server, but selected context goes to the model provider.
Development mode lacks production OS isolation. The repository is AGPL-3.0-only with component exceptions in NOTICE;
the hosted billing/operations code and website are not included. This index describes repository documentation,
not a guarantee of feature availability, search indexing or model behavior.

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/trina-app/trina-ax/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): Prepared-Mac demo with synthetic data.
- [Examples](https://github.com/trina-app/trina-ax/blob/main/docs/EXAMPLES.md): File access and a reusable SKILL.md.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/trina-app/trina-ax/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md): Deployment choices and limitations.
- [한국어](https://github.com/trina-app/trina-ax/blob/main/README.ko.md): Korean overview.
